name: elagoht/prometheus
description: A collage plugin that exports the framework's metrics to Prometheus, and serves them at /metrics.
setup: Hand the same value to `Config.Observability.Metrics` as well as `Config.Plugins`, or `/metrics` serves only the runtime's metrics: `m := prometheus.New(prometheus.Options{})`, then `Observability: collage.ObservabilityConfig{Metrics: m}` and `Plugins: []collage.Plugin{m}`. To require a bearer token, put it in an environment variable and set `"tokenEnv"` to its name.

config.description: A collage plugin that exports the framework's metrics to Prometheus, and serves them at /metrics.

path.description: Path is where the metrics are served. Default "/metrics"; "-" serves them nowhere, for an application that serves its registry itself.

tokenEnv.description: TokenEnv names the environment variable holding the bearer token. When set, the variable must hold one, and it is used instead of Token.
